name: spine-deck-properties
body: Spine completion [autonomous]. requirements.requirement.deck-properties drove only domain.value.deck-config and domain.value.deck-properties; `realised-by` applies only from a domain group|entity|service, so the spine dead-ended. Added `drives` -> domain.entity.deck (the deck config that carries the `properties:` block). domain.entity.deck is already realised-by solution.component.deck-loader. Added `implemented-by` solution.component.deck-loader -> internal/deck.parseProperties (the typed-scalar properties parser; internal/deck.LoadConfig was already anchored). Path: deck-properties -> deck -> deck-loader -> internal/deck.parseProperties. Existing `drives` to the two value nodes kept.
